title: EV Auto App
subtitle: Slate Auto
description: 3 day design sprint to create a concept for an electric vehicle app focused on user experience and branding.

sections.label: Question
sections.heading: What makes EV ownership feel effortless?
sections.body: Slate Auto is a concept for an electric vehicle app that I designed during a 3-day sprint. The goal was to create a user experience that made EV ownership feel seamless and enjoyable, while also maintaining a strong brand identity.

sections.label: Proposition
sections.heading: Map the journey before designing the destination.
sections.body: I started by researching the pain points of current EV apps and identifying opportunities for improvement. I then sketched out user flows and wireframes, focusing on features like range tracking, charging station navigation, and maintenance reminders.

sections.label: Solution
sections.heading: Bold, minimal, and unmistakably Slate.
sections.body: The visual design was inspired by the sleek, modern industrial minimalist aesthetics of the Slate truck, using a monochrome color palette and clean typography. I created a high-fidelity prototype in Figma to showcase the interactions and branding.

title: AI Wedding Planner
subtitle: PlanwithCoCo.com
description: Built the full technical infrastructure and led UX design for an AI-powered wedding planning platform. From architecture decisions to user testing and deployment.

sections.label: Question
sections.heading: Why is wedding planning still so overwhelming?
sections.body: PlanwithCoCo is an AI-powered wedding planning platform designed to simplify one of the most complex personal projects a couple undertakes. As CTO and Lead Designer, I owned the product end-to-end — from the initial system architecture to the final user flows.

sections.label: Proposition
sections.heading: AI should feel like a helpful friend, not a form.
sections.body: The platform uses large language models to generate personalized planning timelines, vendor recommendations, and budget breakdowns based on each couple's inputs. I designed the conversation-first UI to feel approachable and human, not transactional.

sections.label: Solution
sections.heading: Full-stack infrastructure for a full-life moment.
sections.body: On the engineering side, I built the full-stack infrastructure with Next.js, integrated OpenAI's API, and deployed on Vercel with a Supabase backend. I also ran multiple rounds of user testing to refine the onboarding experience.

title: Zira
subtitle: Production Dashboard
description: Led marketing and branding initiatives while contributing to computer vision AI modeling for a production analytics dashboard.

sections.label: Question
sections.heading: How do you turn raw sensor data into operator clarity?
sections.body: Zira is a production analytics platform that uses computer vision to monitor manufacturing lines in real time. I joined as Design Lead and took ownership of the brand identity, marketing site, and dashboard UX — while also contributing to the computer vision pipeline.

sections.label: Proposition
sections.heading: Understand the data at the source before designing for it.
sections.body: The dashboard needed to surface complex sensor and camera data in a way that line operators could act on quickly. I designed a high-density data layout with customizable views and alert hierarchies, tested with operators on the floor.

sections.label: Solution
sections.heading: A dual-role approach: design and machine learning.
sections.body: On the ML side, I contributed to labeling pipelines and model evaluation workflows for the anomaly detection system. The dual role gave me insight into how the data was produced and how it should be presented.

title: Apex Semi
subtitle: Acquired by Cadence, 2024
description: Created a customer-facing Django dashboard with LDAP security integration for a semiconductor company. The company was acquired by Cadence Design Systems in 2024.

sections.label: Question
sections.heading: How do you build trust with enterprise chip engineers?
sections.body: Apex Semi is a semiconductor IP company that needed a secure, customer-facing dashboard for licensing and analytics. I built the frontend in Django with a custom LDAP authentication layer, giving enterprise clients role-based access to their data.

sections.label: Proposition
sections.heading: Design the data model alongside the interface.
sections.body: The design challenge was balancing the density of technical data with a clean, professional interface that matched the expectations of engineers at large chip companies. I worked closely with the backend team to design the data model alongside the UI.

sections.label: Solution
sections.heading: Secure, precise, and proven — acquired by Cadence.
sections.body: Apex Semi was acquired by Cadence Design Systems in 2024, validating the product's technical foundation and the quality of the engineering and design work that went into it.
